text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you got it! Splendid job, 
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Such intricate craftsmanship, even up 
close... I'll take it home and observe it 
thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's so incredibly cute... It 
makes me want to try dressing it up in all 
kinds of outfits♪"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
There might be outfits that suit them 
precisely *because* they're 'Paka Petit' 
figures rather than the real thing, don't 
you think?♪
